population_selection: Six Shanghai communities, 2007-2008; excludes previously diagnosed diabetes and specified medical, questionnaire and age exclusions, retaining screen-detected diabetes. Explicit exclusion under age 20 differs from prose over age 20; exact boundary unresolved. Source context: CTX_BAO_ANALYZED.
measurement: FPG plasma mmol/L; HPLC HbA1c percent; no serum conversion
moment_derivation: mathematical_properties.md: common Gaussian copula, actual marginal transforms, uniform covariance identity and independent source nuisance assumptions; calculated by analytic/calculate.py; lognormal covariance m_i*m_j*expm1(s_i*s_j*rho_ij)
